content.text:
Pit **v0.36.4** is released: https://github.com/cv/pit/releases/tag/v0.36.4. Pit's `typescript` tool now has the `present` field for pi-action's workflow log. I haven't seen it in a real pi-action log yet, because pi-action doesn't read the field until cv/pi-action#80 merges.

**What the log will show**
- **When a call starts:** the title is the label from the `// @pit:` header, or the `label` argument. If there's no label, it's the program's first line. The details show the program without its header, then `params` as JSON, then `functionId` and `saveOnly` if set. It works the same whether pi-action stores the arguments as the model sent them or after pit has moved the header into them.
- **When it ends:** the `↳` line lists the functions the program injected, such as `workspace.read · git.status`. A `saveOnly` call shows `saved <name>`, and a failed call shows the first line of the error. The details show the returned value: string fields such as `content` or `stdout` as they are, and other values as indented JSON. If pit cut the value down to fit its size limit, the details end with a note saying so.
- If a stored call or result doesn't have the shape the tool normally produces, these functions throw. pi-action's documented behaviour is then to show its generic view and warn once.

The code is in `src/durable/present.ts`, attached to the tool in `src/durable/tool.ts`. `test/durable/present.test.ts` runs real programs through pi-durable and checks both views. I also added a paragraph to `docs/durable.md` and a changelog entry.

**Release**
- Check, tests, coverage and the package check all passed locally.
- PR #373 passed CI and was rebase-merged. It holds the feature commit (with `Closes #372`) and the version bump to 0.36.4, including the pinned install line in the README.
- After CI passed on `main`, I tagged `v0.36.4`. The Release workflow succeeded.
- `release.verifyPublished` found the tag on the right commit and no assets. A fresh install of the tag runs the sandbox.

This repo's own `pi-assistant.yml` still runs pit `v0.36.3`. Moving it to `v0.36.4` and removing pi-action's own `// @pit:` parsing are both left for after cv/pi-action#80 merges.
